audit_summary: Every major LLM request audited for input token efficiency

semantic_extraction.note: Semantic extraction is deterministic, no LLM input

rag_retrieval.note: RAG uses nomic-embed-text, not LLM. Embedding dimensions: 768.

transformation_planning.note: Planning tasks receive minimal context: subsystem summary + dependency slice. Not raw source.

code_generation_design_notes.note: Design note generation receives targeted context: specific module info + business rules. Not full source.

repair_diagnosis.note: Repair diagnosis receives compilation error + RAG context. Targeted, not full source.

total_input_tokens.note: Input tokens are already minimal. Each LLM call receives ~53 input tokens on average. This is highly efficient.

output_tokens.note: Output is fixed at 160 tokens per design note. Deterministic output length.

context_efficiency_improvements.improvement: Already deterministic - no LLM context needed
Top-k=3 retrieval with similarity filtering. Only relevant context sent to LLM.
Receives dependency slice + subsystem summary, not raw source
Receives targeted module info + business rules, not full source
Receives compilation error + RAG-retrieved domain context

conclusion: Context efficiency is already near-optimal. Average 53 input tokens per LLM call. No LLM call receives raw source. All context is targeted: dependency slices, business rules, RAG results, compilation errors. Further reduction would risk losing necessary context.
